purpose: Fresh 7B language-LoRA GRPO, learning rate 5e-5, seed 42, 1,000 optimizer steps; final checkpoint evaluated on the full fixed validation64 cohort.
reward: R_fmt + binary foreground IoU against full instance masks; no count, separation or topology reward.

optimizer_evidence.adapter_changed_steps_definition: Count of steps whose adapter differs from its initial weights; not a comparison against the preceding step.

resources.training_elapsed_definition: Training-loop elapsed, including periodic evaluations and checkpoint work; not the sum of optimizer-step durations.

data.selection: Official-30 MoNuSeg training sources, patient-disjoint train/validation partition; selected native 128x128 crops with 1-8 annotated nuclei. This run evaluates all 64 validation crops; benchmark8 is not pooled into a separate metric.

example_selection_rule: Lexicographically first ID with GT count exactly 1 and first with GT count >1; no output-based selection

evidence.raw_answers: before_records.jsonl and after_records.jsonl preserve all source completion records byte-for-byte.

conclusion: Final-checkpoint macro PQ rose from 0.0226549 to 0.0404478 and matched nuclei from 9 to 12 of 384. Count MAE and format validity improved; same-GT duplicate extras rose from 0 to 2. Final PQ is higher than the matched 1e-5 seed42 run, but this one-seed validation comparison does not establish a robust winner. Most nuclei remain unmatched.
limitations: The same 64 selected validation crops from four patients are reused for monitoring and setting selection, not an untouched final test.
This report uses the final 1,000-step checkpoint, not the best intermediate validation checkpoint. Nine periodic evaluations occurred during training.
Only 12 of 384 nuclei match at the evaluation threshold; a higher foreground-IoU reward does not establish reliable instance detection.
The learning-rate comparison holds checkpoint, data, seed and requested/completed steps fixed, but uses one seed and validation; no robust winner is established.
No pooling with benchmark8. Full-mask reward engineering; no weak-label, SOTA or clinical claim.
invalid_answer_handling: Two of 64 before answers are rejected as whole responses; all 64 after answers are format-valid. Rejected answers have empty final masks and remain in all metric denominators. Exact raw text is retained.

learning_rate_comparison.interpretation: 5e-5 has the higher final macro PQ in this controlled seed42 validation comparison. Differences are small in matched nuclei; one seed and reused validation do not establish a robust preferred setting.
